Si la obra deja de ser de la tenencia de: When an artwork leaves the artist's possession and passes to a new owner, a new provenance record can be created (with the new owner's basic or anonymous data) and a Certificate of Authenticity (COA) generated with a special cryptographic ID. The new owner, when accessing the artwork's technical record via the QR code, can validate its legality using the cryptographic ID associated with their COA, gaining an additional tool to prove their right of possession.
